newsitem.title: USA: Nu Skin comfortable with 1996 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Nu Skin comfortable with 1996 estimates.

text.p: Nu Skin Asia Pacific Inc said on Sunday that it is comfortable with analysts' 1996 year-end estimates.
Wall Street is expecting the company to report $0.23 per share for the fourth quarter and $0.91 for the year, according to First Call estimates.
The company said it would release year-end earnings February 19.
The company said active distributors in the company's markets increased by more than 10 percent in the fourth quarter, and that as of December 31, active distributors totaled more than 375,000.
The company said in a release it also is launching several new product lines. Nu Skin Japan will launch two nutrition products and a new skin care system, the company said.
